_about: End-launch connector and launch data for the coupons (validation/test_board/README.md). Dimensions in mm. 'verified': false marks values that are NOT taken from a vendor drawing and must be checked before ordering.

swm_narrow.series: End Launch Connectors, narrow block (.350 in), clamp-on, solderless (pin interference fit, soldering optional)

sma.what: SuperSMA jack (female), DC-27 GHz, PCB thickness .040-.090 in (1.02-2.29 mm), pin dia .010 in

k292.what: 2.92 mm jack (female), DC-40 GHz, PCB thickness .040-.090 in; mates with SMA and 3.5 mm

swm_narrow.why_14: The -9 variants accept boards only up to .065 in (1.65 mm); JLC's 1.6 mm boards may be up to 1.76 mm (+/-10 %), so the -14 (.040-.090 in) range is the safe choice.

sources.price: not published (no distributor price found on 2026-10-22); quote from Southwest Microwave or its representative

footprint.warning: PLACEHOLDER. The '.350 Transition Block PCB Footprint' drawing in the catalog could not be read in this workspace (drawing only, no text). Mounting-hole size and positions, the ground-contact area and the block depth below are guesses chosen to stay inside the block width; replace them with the vendor drawing (or ask Southwest Microwave for the launch design for this stackup) before ordering.
footprint.edge_pullback_src: JLCPCB: copper >= 0.2 mm from routed edges (capabilities page)
footprint.mount_holes_note: x from the board edge into the board, y across; NPTH; GUESS - check against the vendor drawing

layout.row_pitch_note: 2-port coupons: one connector per edge per row; only one row is connected at a time. 12.7 mm (0.5 in) leaves 3.8 mm between two narrow blocks.
layout.pair_pitch_note: 4-port coupons: two connectors side by side on each edge. 12.7 mm leaves 3.8 mm between the blocks and about 3.5 mm between two 8 mm coupling nuts; check torque-wrench access with the actual cables and raise to 15 mm if needed (the generator takes --pair-pitch).
layout.feed_note: board edge to the reference plane of every 2-port coupon (half of the 25 mm 2xthru)
layout.feed_4port_note: 4-port coupons (pairs): the 45° fan-in from the connector pitch to the 1.0 mm via pitch needs room beyond the connector block; their own pair 2×thru has the same 15 mm
layout.via_src: JLCPCB capabilities: via hole >= 0.15 mm, annular ring >= 0.15 mm; inner-layer hole-to-copper >= 0.2 mm (so an antipad of a 0.3 mm via must be >= 0.7 mm in diameter); via hole-to-hole >= 0.2 mm
